title: Erdős #117 OQ: Exponential Growth Rate Convergence
description: Does the exponential growth rate of the abelian covering number h(n) converge? Pyber (1987) showed c₁^n < h(n) < c₂^n. The open question is whether lim h(n)^{1/n} exists.
